# SQLite

The SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation, from https://sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip (SHA-256 `1e71ddf93849c6a6ecf58b827c0692073d2dd7ee40196158068f7b29f422e87d`), in the public domain. The Android app compiles it instead of downloading a prebuilt library, which F-Droid refuses. Keep its version that of the libraries prebuilt by the `sqlite3` package.
